usage: noble.py [-h] [-l | -L] [-o FILE | -s] [--version] [model]

Retrieve Connor Hill's noble polyhedra and output them as OFF on stdout.

OFF library embedded in this script.

positional arguments:

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  -l, --list         list the noble polyhedra catalog
  -L, --long-list    list historical names, duals, discoverers, and years

  -s, --save         write OFF output using Hill's original filename in the
